Capsules offer a convenient and standardized dosage, making it easier to incorporate into daily routines. Oils are used topically for muscle relaxation and pain relief, while teas are consumed for their calming and circulatory benefits. These preparations have been valued for centuries in various cultures for their potential health-enhancing properties.
